Acceptance criteria: You can freely roam the large map, trigger multiple branch plots, and complete the main objectives. Output a single complete self-contained HTML file, use importmap to introduce threejs, zero external resources, and have a complete game closed loop: start interface, game loop, plot advancement, victory/settlement interface; localStorage stores progress; semi-finished demos are prohibited.

items.brief_en: Create a 3D linear narrative plot demo, based on Three.js, importmap import library, single HTML, all resources are generated programmatically. Fixed script plot, camera keyframe animation cutscenes; first-person perspective, players move freely around the small villa scene, triggering plot nodes to advance the story; a large number of dialogue pop-up DOM overlays; environmental narrative: item reading, notes, recorded text; a small number of selective branches to change subsequent shots and dialogue; no fierce battles, focusing on atmospheric narrative. Art: Realistic and simple interior 3D, soft PBR material, post-production glow. Acceptance criteria: Complete the story flow, with at least 2 selected branches producing differentiated plot segments; the game can be restarted. Output a single complete self-contained HTML file, use importmap to introduce threejs, zero external resources, and have a complete game closed loop: start interface, game loop, plot advancement, victory/settlement interface; localStorage stores progress; semi-finished demos are prohibited.

items.technology_en: 原生 WebGPU，万级粒子 GPU 并行更新，爆炸冲击波，色彩渐变
items.brief_en: Native WebGPU implements high-performance combat particle systems. Click to trigger large-scale explosion particles, shock wave diffusion, and color attenuation; all particle updates are completed in parallel on the GPU without blocking the main line. Acceptance criteria: 10,000-level particles run smoothly and special effects levels are complete. Output a single complete self-contained HTML file, zero external resources, complete interactive closed loop, and no semi-finished products.
